title: Reconciling droplet freezing parameterizations with cloud top phase and ice number observations: code and run configurations
description: Patches against CAM tag cam_cesm2_1_rel_60 of CESM 2.1.5 that add a droplet freezing limiter for mineral dust (limfacdu), the Niemand et al. (2012) dust immersion freezing schemes, a switch for the MG2 ice-number cap and related microphysics factors and diagnostics. The repository also contains the run namelists and case scripts of the CESM2/CAM6 (MG2) simulations of Villanueva et al. (in review). Release 1.0.3 changes only documentation and metadata; the code is identical to release 1.0.1.
